image_description: A Nile crocodile is partially submerged in murky water near a grassy bank. The head and anterior body are visible on the left, mostly underwater or obscured by low-hanging grass, while the armored dorsal ridge and tail extend towards the right, cutting through the vegetation. The lighting suggests daylight, casting shadows on the textured skin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is largely submerged and obscured by foreground grass; the specific V-shape geometry cannot be clearly verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is closed and underwater/obscured; individual teeth are not visible for verification.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eyes are either below the water line or hidden by the angle and vegetation; pupil shape and membrane are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tip of the snout is obscured by water and grass; nostrils cannot be located.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body clearly shows an elongated form with heavy armor plating along the spine.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct, raised bony scutes are clearly visible in longitudinal rows along the back and tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration matches the dark/grey description, and the texture appears rough and knobby as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral side (belly) is completely submerged and not visible in this view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All limbs are submerged or hidden by the body and vegetation; digit count and webbing cannot be seen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible extending into the grass; it appears muscular and consistent with crocodilian anatomy, though the full length proportion is hard to judge due to occlusion.
